instructions: Choose the next event for the stacking task. Follow the requested bottom-to-top order and choose only an event whose conditions are satisfied by the state.

criteria_templates.stop_authorize: Stop at this safe task boundary without executing the next stage.
criteria_templates.establish_base: Establish the first requested cube as the table-supported base.
criteria_templates.stop_base: Stop the stacking workflow without moving the robot.
criteria_templates.stack_next: Place the next required cube ({next_cube}) on the current support ({current_support}).
criteria_templates.stop_placement: Stop the stacking workflow at the current safe boundary.
criteria_templates.finish: Finish because all requested cubes have been placed.
criteria_templates.stop_finish: Stop the workflow at the current safe boundary.
